tasks.title: Point-in-time Korean equity strategy research and compounding ledger
tasks.why: The stock research path mixed legacy feature provenance with incomplete temporal validation, one-shot simulation, and ambiguous promotion evidence.
tasks.resolution: Added deterministic provisional legacy-panel certification, point-in-time feature and label contracts, stable Rank-IC composite derivation, purged walk-forward promotion, constrained target weights, effective-dated costs, settlement-aware multi-session ledger, rebalance exits, and independent stress evaluation.
tasks.impact: Strategy results are reproducible and fail closed to NO_TRADE when out-of-sample evidence, cost stress, capacity, or ledger invariants do not pass; KIS live integration remains a later boundary.

tasks.title: Consolidate legacy/modern package duplication
tasks.why: The refactored tree still exposed duplicate etf/etfs roots and retained historical file layouts, reducing AI navigation efficiency and obscuring ownership.
tasks.resolution: Consolidated shared contracts under core/storage, organized stocks and ETFs by research/trading/backtesting/workflows, rebuilt execution around intents/orders/readiness, and quarantined historical implementations under src/legacy with parity coverage.
tasks.impact: Stock and ETF boundaries are explicit, legacy code is isolated, new ML/research components are replaceable, and the architecture remains extensible without reintroducing duplicate roots.

tasks.title: Separate stock and ETF architecture with replaceable ML
tasks.why: Historical stock YetiRank, ETF strategy, data processing, simulation, and unfinished execution paths were coupled and lacked explicit asset boundaries.
tasks.resolution: Introduced explicit core asset contracts, isolated stocks and etfs packages, point-in-time ML dataset/split/artifact boundaries, ETF parity fixtures, and paper-only execution gates; aligned filters tests and quality tooling with the migration boundary.
tasks.impact: Research and simulation paths are structurally separated; legacy modules remain excluded/read-only during migration, and live order submission remains gated.
